title: Test suite: ingest tests
description: Add ingest test classes to .claude/skills/agent-memory/tests/test_memory.py. Uses the same _TempDirTest base and mocked _embed from the core test bead. Implement: TestIngestTxt (paragraph chunking, short chunks skipped), TestIngestMd (heading boundaries respected, heading text at start of chunk), TestIngestJson (string array, object array with content key, invalid input exits 1), TestIngestCsv (--column flag selects text column, other columns become metadata).
acceptance_criteria: TestIngestTxt: 3-paragraph .txt produces 3 rows; chunk shorter than 10 chars is skipped and reported
TestIngestMd: chunk following ## heading starts with the heading text
TestIngestJson string array: adds one row per element
TestIngestJson object array: adds one row per object using 'content' key
TestIngestJson invalid input: exits 1 with descriptive error
TestIngestCsv: adds one row per data row; non-text columns appear in metadata JSON
All new test classes pass with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/

handoff_summary.completed: Added TestIngestTxt, TestIngestMd, TestIngestJson, TestIngestCsv test classes to tests/test_memory.py covering all 6 acceptance criteria items.
handoff_summary.risks: The 3-paragraph→3-rows test relies on chunk_size=50 forcing paragraph splits; if _chunk_txt merging logic changes this may need adjustment. The short-chunk test assumes "Hi." (3 chars) is below the MIN_CHUNK_LEN=10 threshold.
handoff_summary.next_action: Run tester agent to execute python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/ and confirm all new test classes pass.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected; only tests/test_memory.py was modified by appending new classes before the integration test section.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used cmd_ingest (the public CLI handler) rather than private _ingest_* helpers so tests validate the full integration path including arg routing. chunk_size tuned per-test to control paragraph-per-chunk behavior.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: All 6 acceptance criteria covered. TestIngestJson adds a 4th case (malformed JSON) beyond the spec for completeness.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Tests depend on _chunk_txt paragraph-merging behavior; chunk_size thresholds chosen to match current implementation.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected; only tests/test_memory.py was modified by appending new classes before the integration test section.

guardrails.template_text:
# Developer Guardrails

Primary responsibility: Implement only the assigned bead inside the existing architecture and file scope.

Allowed actions:
- Modify code, configuration, or local docs required to complete the assigned bead.
- Create sub-beads for discovered follow-up work that should be handled separately.
- Verify your `Python` changes compile and import correctly with a quick syntax check: `python -m py_compile`.

Disallowed actions:
- Run any test suite — not even a targeted `pytest` run or any subset. Test execution is exclusively the tester agent's responsibility. Running tests wastes the agent budget and delays the pipeline.
- Redesign unrelated architecture or broaden scope beyond the assigned bead.
- Perform final review signoff in place of a review agent.
- Silently absorb unrelated test, documentation, or planning work that should be handed off.

Expected outputs:
- Completed or blocked JSON with concise implementation summary.
- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
